scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,desktop -c green,cyan "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
scripts.postinstall:electron: cd node_modules/electron && node install.js && echo -n 'Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron' > path.txt
